Definition: Shima, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shimea = "fame"; 1) son of David by Bathsheba; 2) brother of David, the 3rd son of Jesse; 2a) also 'Shammah', 'Shimma', and 'Shimeah'; 3) a Gershonite Levite, father of Berachiah, and grandfather of Asaph; 4) a Merarite Levite, son of Uzzah, and father of Haggiah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
